name: Indicator groups
description: Every indicator group and its sub-groups

name: Indicator group fields
description: The fields (indicators) inside one group

name: Indicator values for one year
description: One field's values in one calendar year (Argaam returns one year per call; without a year, only the latest)

name: Commodities
description: Every commodity Argaam tracks, with its type: Regular (exchange-traded), Shipping (freight rates) or Others

name: Latest commodity quotes
description: The latest quote of each actively traded commodity: open, close, high, low, change

name: Commodity price history
description: Every end-of-day price of one Regular commodity between two dates (yyyy-MM-dd)

name: Other commodity history
description: The price history of one Others commodity (milk powders, refining margins), per region

name: Shipping rates
description: The freight-rate history of one Shipping commodity (tankers, dry bulk, bunker fuel)

name: Refining margins
description: Daily refining margins between two dates

name: Consumer goods
description: Every consumer good (material) Argaam tracks, by category

name: Latest consumer goods prices
description: The latest price of every consumer good, by category

name: Consumer good price history
description: Every recorded price of one consumer good between two dates

name: Petrochemical index (latest)
description: The latest value of the Argaam Petrochemical Price Index and its change

name: Petrochemical index history
description: Every value of the Argaam Petrochemical Price Index between two dates

name: Petrochemical products
description: Every petrochemical product Argaam tracks, with its region and latest price

name: Petrochemical product price history
description: Every recorded price of one petrochemical product in one region between two dates

name: Market valuation
description: A market's current P/E, price-to-book and dividend yield (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU)

name: Companies in a market
description: Every company listed on a market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU)

name: Analyst estimates
description: Analyst estimates for one company, yearly or quarterly

name: Financial results of a market
description: Every company's net income for one period, with last year's value and the change (period year/quarter/interim, fiscalPeriod year, q1-q4, i1-i3)

name: Latest financial statements
description: The latest income statement, balance sheet and cash flow of one company, yearly or quarterly

name: Financial statements for one period
description: One company's statements for one past period: period year with fiscalPeriod 1, or period quarter with fiscalPeriod 2-5 (Q1-Q4)

name: Latest financial ratios
description: About 48 ratios (growth, margins, returns, valuation) of one company, latest year or quarter

name: Financial ratios for one period
description: One company's ratios for one past period: period year with fiscalPeriod 1, or period quarter with fiscalPeriod 2-5 (Q1-Q4)

name: Key financial highlights
description: The headline numbers of one company's latest results (sales, net income, ...)

name: Financial report files
description: Links to one company's published financial statements (PDF, Arabic and English)

name: Analyst opinions in a market
description: Broker ratings (Buy, Overweight, Hold, ...) with target prices for every covered company, one page

name: Company ranking
description: Companies ranked highest first by one metric (market-value, net-income, return-on-equity, ...)

name: Lowest 20 companies
description: The 20 companies with the lowest price-earnings or price-per-book

name: Market ratios
description: The market's P/E, P/B and value, with or without Saudi Aramco

name: Analyst estimates vs actuals
description: Each broker's estimate of one field for one year, next to the actual reported value

name: Consensus estimates in a market
description: The average analyst estimate of one field for every covered company, with the actual value

name: Fund managers
description: Every fund-management firm Argaam tracks, with how many funds each has

name: Funds of a manager
description: The funds run by one fund manager

name: Fund details
description: One fund in full: objective, strategy, eligibility, fees, minimums, size, start date

name: Fund price history
description: Every end-of-day unit price and net asset value of one fund between two dates (yyyy-MM-dd)

name: Fund latest value
description: One fund's latest unit price, net asset value and return this year, with the date of that price

name: Top-moving funds
description: The 10 funds that gained most and the 10 that lost most this year

name: M&A deals in a market
description: Every merger, acquisition and stake deal in one market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU), newest first: date, value, type, status, acquirers, targets

name: M&A deal details
description: One deal's full record: everything in the market list plus how it was financed (financialWaysList)

name: Projects in a market
description: Every capital project in one market (3 = TASI, 14 = NOMU), newest first: name, country, cost, status, start and expected completion. Fetched as one big page (page=1, pageSize=5000); some projects repeat in identical rows

name: Project details
description: One project's full record: description, category, city, cost and its unit, dates, owner and related companies, comments, production capacity

name: Company key developments
description: A company's dated key developments (stock symbol, e.g. 2222), each with links to the Argaam article
